description: This file defines a utility class 'ObjectUtils' with static methods for manipulating JSON objects, specifically for handling boolean and string entries, and serializing boolean values to JSON strings.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for JSON object manipulation related to boolean and string entries.

methods.name: HasBooleanEntry
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object contains a boolean value for a given key and retrieves it.

methods.name: CreateBooleanJsonString
methods.description: Creates a JSON string representing a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: CreateBooleanObject
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: AddBooleanEntry
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to an existing JSON object.

methods.name: HasStringEntry
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object contains a string value for a given key and retrieves it.

methods.name: BoolToJsonString
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value to a JSON string 'true' or 'false'.
